purpose: 允许并行诊断、研究、实现和测试；对共享生产状态实行价值/残余风险准入、隔离实施、latest-main重放、文件所有权和串行集成约束。

normative_contract.source: docs/生产变更与并发写入协议_V1.0.md
normative_contract.migration_note: V1.9 is a governance reduction over V1.8; V1.8 hard safety invariants remain mandatory.

value_priority_contract.rule: 生产维护、GitHub操作、CI、workflow、acceptance、observability与治理服务于交易价值，不得反客为主；当维护与交易主链争夺注意力或资源时，优先保障会改变实际交易判断、可实现收益、风险暴露或资本效率的工作。
value_priority_contract.user_action_boundary: 若某一步只能或最适合由用户在外部界面完成，ChatGPT应提供最小明确的人工操作指引，然后继续承担其余判断、复核和闭环；不得在工具能力边界内反复轮询、等待或制造替代链。

merged_main_failure_attribution.closure_rule: change-specific acceptance must pass; introduced or inconclusive attribution cannot close; reliable preexisting or new unrelated attribution does not mechanically block independent closure

governance_principles.decision_and_timing: decide whether the change has clear net value and whether any critical residual risk still requires future evidence; closed-market pre-open midday-break post-close and holiday windows may be valid maintenance windows; a real production exposure window is required only when the residual risk cannot be closed before merge
governance_principles.root_cause_complete_repair: diagnose root cause first; repair at the highest lawful canonical owner; minimum fix means the smallest root-cause-complete fix; same-root-cause symptoms form one repair unit; a repeated patch for the same root cause triggers renewed end-to-end diagnosis
governance_principles.scope_and_validation: preserve unrelated contracts; validate original failure adjacent state or session boundaries and the previously normal case; research production integration must validate PIT object scope automatic data failure degradation execution bridge consumption and anti-drift
governance_principles.serialized_integration_and_residual_risk: parallel research diagnosis implementation and tests are allowed; independent production changes integrate serially on latest main; after each merge complete main full consistency and E2E; do not impose a calendar wait unless unresolved residual risk specifically requires a real production exposure window

change_admission.work_concurrency: EXECUTE_NOW permits immediate isolated audit diagnosis implementation testing candidate replay PR and CI preparation when shared production main is not written; an unfinished predecessor does not convert the admission to OBSERVE.
change_admission.production_integration: Independent production changes integrate serially on latest main; a predecessor wait is an integration queue state, not a fourth admission outcome. Merge and merged-main acceptance remain blocked until the predecessor is complete.
change_admission.priority_semantics: Priority controls interruption, resource allocation, and integration order; it does not mechanically freeze independent lower-priority diagnosis implementation or testing.
change_admission.decision_rule: 先判断变化是否有清晰净收益，再判断是否仍有必须等待的新信息。价值和实现/验证均充分且无关键残余风险需要未来真实生产暴露时为EXECUTE_NOW；存在明确且必须通过后续真实生产运行或未完成验证才能回答的问题时为OBSERVE；净收益不足、已有机制充分、已满足/替代或复杂度收益不成立时为DO_NOT_CHANGE。
change_admission.execution_boundary: 用户提出修复、优化或执行不自动等于EXECUTE_NOW。ChatGPT/Codex必须先完成问题事实、canonical owner、根因、当前影响、既有恢复是否充分、实现成熟度和残余风险判断。EXECUTE_NOW进入既有latest-main隔离实施与组合验收链；OBSERVE必须记录具体阻塞和解除条件；DO_NOT_CHANGE不创建生产修改。A股连续交易期间仅执行影响当前交易判断、账户/成交/行情事实或canonical runtime恢复的必要生产修改，其他EXECUTE_NOW事项移至非关键窗口执行。
change_admission.maintenance_rule_freeze: 长期治理只保留四条上位原则和少量硬工程合同；旧CA01-CA11仅作为审计兼容映射，不再作为日常平级入口，不继续新增CA12/CA13等规则。新失效模式优先归并到现有原则并强化测试，只有现有原则确实无法覆盖且问题重复、实质影响生产时才调整规范。

review_closure_contract.rule: 待变更、OBSERVE、待激活和待运行态验证事项必须能从当前正式Issue/PR、canonical运行状态或正式变更记录恢复；每次复核按latest main重新分类。定时复核只负责唤醒和防遗漏，不复制稳定治理规则，不新建平行pending状态。

new_work_item_gate.name: NEW_WORK_ITEM_GATE
new_work_item_gate.purpose: 在新的研究、优化、维护或非紧急修复Issue创建前，判断其是否值得成为独立正式事项；不替代后续生产变更准入。

outcomes.pass_rule: PASS requires no reusable same-semantic item, material action/reliability impact, existing mechanisms insufficient, and sufficient evidence; PASS is required before creating an independent new Issue.
outcomes.fail_rule: FAIL defaults to NEW_ISSUE=NO; continue operating, reuse, wait for informative evidence, or close.
outcomes.admission_orthogonality: NEW_WORK_ITEM_GATE is orthogonal to change_admission.decision_outcomes; it does not add an admission outcome.

emergency_fast_path.rule: Emergency recovery may enter the existing governance chain without mechanically requiring repeated evidence; root-cause, scope, validation and integration rules still apply.

new_work_item_gate.duplicate_reuse_contract: Search current Issues/PRs and reuse an existing same-semantic item or mechanism before creating a new Issue.

formal_file_mutation_contract.rule: 业务脚本可以分别负责账户同步、成交/复盘事件和已确认费用纠错，但对三份人类可读正式事实文件的低层managed-block/upsert/write必须统一经过canonical gateway；gateway绝不允许写MASTER。

shared_writer_families.reason: 两条链使用同一A股核心producer并可能写CURRENT/runtime及快照，必须共享串行队列。

.github/workflows/akshare-capability-poc.rule: PoC结果仅作为短期验证证据，不持久化main。

.github/workflows/minute-source-poc.yml.rule: 分钟源能力验证只保留Actions artifact；正式启用必须另走生产转化。

.github/workflows/minute-path-shadow.yml.rule: shadow输出不属于正式decision context；只做短期artifact留档，不直接写main。

.github/workflows/self-healing-watchdog..allowed_mutation: CURRENT.rules_version only when MASTER metadata drift is detected

data/state/CURRENT.json.rule: 行情价格、时点、快照指针和market phase只能来自canonical snapshot producer；自愈不得重建行情事实。

data/state/runtime_health.json.rule: A股runtime health随canonical snapshot producer生成；海外、通知、研究和一致性workflow不得持久化该文件。

data/state/decision_context.json.rule: 允许多个受控入口触发，但所有持久化版本必须由同一个canonical builder从当时最新正式事实重建，不允许workflow手工拼接。

data/state/query_context.json.rule: 允许A股核心和自愈入口重建，但所有持久化版本必须调用同一个canonical builder；海外scheduled pulse只发布海外市场事实与runtime health，正式请求按需从这些事实重建query_context；system-consistency只可临时重建用于审计，不应把query_context作为自身owned state提交。

data/state/decision_trigger.json.rule: 重评触发状态必须由现有Phase4 builder经build_state_context从最新正式事实重建；self-healing调用build_state_context时必须与decision_context同批持久化，禁止保留旧schema或旧规则语义。

data/state/capital_efficiency_ranking.js.rule: 该文件只枚举完整资本比较全集和数据/执行约束，不生成综合分数或机器主候选；self-healing调用build_state_context时必须与decision_context同批持久化。

fact_precedence: ETF规则_MASTER.md > 派生状态与历史聊天
用户确认或券商确认的实际成交 > 辅助权益/历史账本重构
最新有效账户事实 > 旧Dashboard或旧缓存
更新的正式复盘事实 > 辅助历史重构
真实provider时点 > workflow计划时间
最新main上的正式源文件 > 旧分支生成的动态状态

TIER_0.description: No production behavior semantics: docs, prompts, presentation, read-only audit, research or artifact-only validation.

TIER_1.description: Single owner, deterministic change with no canonical writer/state/PIT/account/trade/authority/topology change.

TIER_2.description: Canonical producer/state, notification state or important runtime contract change without account/trade facts, PIT qualification, MASTER, authority, writer ownership or topology change.

TIER_3.description: Account, trade, PIT/freshness qualification, writer ownership, MASTER/authority, concurrency topology or irreversible production behavior change.

path_classes.docs_prompts_display: TIER_0 only when pure presentation/no production behavior semantics
path_classes.behavior_semantic_prompt_or_doc: TIER_1 minimum; TIER_2 when important runtime contract; TIER_3 on high-risk flags

T2-F.description: Tier 2 fact/runtime route: the change can alter a canonical fact, formal-decision input, freshness/tradability interpretation, required persistence, or an important runtime contract.
T2-F.selection_rule: Use when any formal decision input, canonical fact/state production, runtime contract, or persistence hard dependency can change; unknown or ambiguous attribution remains fail-safe.
T2-F.merged_main_full_consistency: only_when_triggered_by_same_failure_domain, core-fact/permission impact, attribution_inconclusive, or current diff introduction/amplification

T2-P.description: Tier 2 projection/maintenance route: projection, notification, review enrichment, or maintenance-only behavior with no change to account/trade/PIT/MASTER/permission/Formal Decision inputs or canonical fact ownership.
T2-P.selection_rule: Use only when the changed output is rebuildable or maintenance-only and the no-core-input condition is evidenced; otherwise route to T2-F.
T2-P.merged_main_full_consistency: not default; retain global result and trigger only under the global blocking conditions

system_subtraction_fast_path.routing: T2-P only when all eligibility conditions are proven; otherwise use the existing risk tier route

root_cause_stop_rule.stop_after: one enumerated boundary matrix is complete

acceptance_evidence_identity.reuse_when: identity unchanged and no reconstruction trigger
acceptance_evidence_identity.dynamic_state_only_reuse_condition: A main advance containing only classified dynamic-state/diagnostic/notification projection changes does not invalidate stable candidate evidence; reuse ends on shared owner/file conflict, behavior semantic change, candidate invalidation, or changed risk identity.

mirror_reduction.note: T2-F/T2-P and subtraction routing are declarative extensions of the existing Tier 2 matrix; no new workflow, checker, state, registry, or acceptance engine.
